main_text.p: quicumque siue caloris, aut frigoris, sunt materiales ; entia vero materiae sed nequeunt penetrare, nam hoc speciebus tantum debetur.

Respond. esse quidem conceptu ficillimum quomodo accidentia materialia in vna, eademq; indiuisibili parte subiecti maneant simul, & idcò semper vsa est probabilior, magis physica veterum sententia, qui excantt qualitatis intensionem per gradum subftantiae additum gradui, in parte materiae indiuisibili, sed fibili, vt in vltima disputatione dicitur. Verum quia fumus in communi doctrina, Respond. gradus qualitatum esse materiales quidem, ita tamen minutos, vt valeant penetrari simul. Et hoc tenentur fateri omnes peripatetici, qui concedunt eamdem subiecti partem habere plura similia accidentia, vt in pomo dulcorem, humiditatem, colorem, &c. Quemadmodum ergo multa haec specie diuersa penetrata manent, similiter manebunt, si numero tantum distincta sint.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan is cropped, so the ends of many lines are cut off and could not be read; words are given only as far as visible, and the partial words at the line ends are uncertain. The bottom-right fragment "DI" may be the start of a larger word or a catchword; it is marked uncertain. The narrow, indented lines form part of the running text and are not a separate column.
